observations.behavior: Adds v1 and v5 API version constants and their corresponding host and metadata, while removing the v5-only Apple Search Ads host and its version-specific lookback constants.
observations.posthog_connection: Connects to Apple's two API versions; v1 uses the Platform API host, v5 uses the Search Ads host. This supports ingestion from both Apple Search Ads and Apple Ads Platform API.

observations.behavior: Adds a set of unpaginatable resource kinds and a mapping of API version to the per-day metric bucket key, while removing the v5-only probe path and its comment.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the ingestion worker to know which resource kinds do not require pagination, and which version uses which metric key, supporting both v1 and v5 API compatibility.

observations.behavior: Makes org_id and ad_account_id optional and adds an ad_account_id field, while removing the org_id field and its comment, and removes the offset field's comment.
observations.posthog_connection: Supports both account-scoped and org-scoped credential storage, allowing the connector to handle both Apple Search Ads and Apple Ads Platform API credential models.
